Definition
Source: topping:page-0011 1. ch1:2.3–ch1:2.5\group ricci-solitons A Ricci soliton is a gradient Ricci soliton if $Y=\nabla f$ for some smooth function $f:\mathcal M\to \mathbb R$. Its equation is \[ \Hess _{g_0}(f)+\Ric (g_0)=\lambda g_0. \]
